text: Assumption: The error kInvalidAccessMode upon Set() is primarily triggered when the template parameter AccessModeType is configured to AccessMode::kRead — is this correct?

assumption: The error kInvalidAccessMode upon Set() is primarily triggered when the template parameter AccessModeType is configured to AccessMode::kRead.
rationale: AP_SWS_SHWA_00011 documents the error for write accesses, whereas the template specifies AccessMode::kRead by default.
